set system services dhcp pool pool1 addr.template: set system services dhcp pool [parameter1] address-range low [parameter2] high [parameter3]
set system services dhcp pool pool1 addr.command: set system services dhcp pool pool1 address-range low 172.30.0.2 high 172.30.0.200
set system services dhcp pool pool1 addr.explanation: 配置DHCP地址池的地址范围。

set system services dhcp pool pool1 defa.template: set system services dhcp pool [parameter1] default-router [parameter2]
set system services dhcp pool pool1 defa.command: set system services dhcp pool pool1 default-router 172.30.0.1
set system services dhcp pool pool1 defa.explanation: 配置DHCP地址池的默认网关。

set system services dhcp pool pool1 name.template: set system services dhcp pool [parameter1] name-server [parameter2]
set system services dhcp pool pool1 name.command: set system services dhcp pool pool1 name-server 172.30.0.1

set system services dhcp pool pool1 excl.template: set system services dhcp pool [parameter1] excluded-address [parameter2]
set system services dhcp pool pool1 excl.command: set system services dhcp pool pool1 excluded-address 172.30.0.8
set system services dhcp pool pool1 excl.explanation: 配置DHCP地址池中排除的地址。

parameters.name: excluded-address
parameters.explanation: 从DHCP地址池中排除的IP地址。

set system login user admin class super-.template: set system login user [parameter1] class [parameter2] authentication plain-text-password [parameter3]
set system login user admin class super-.command: set system login user admin class super-user authentication plain-text-password "<password>"
set system login user admin class super-.explanation: 配置系统登录用户的认证方式为明文密码。

set system services aaa authentication-o.command: set system services aaa authentication-order tacplus local

set system services aaa authorization-or.command: set system services aaa authorization-order local

set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family et.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching vlan members [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family et.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members 100
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family et.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换VLAN成员。

set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 1 encapsula.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 1 encapsulation vlan-ccc

set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 1 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 1 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 1 family inet address 172.30.0.2/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 1 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

set interfaces vlan.100 family inet addr.command: set interfaces vlan.100 family inet address 172.30.0.1/24
set interfaces vlan.100 family inet addr.explanation: 配置VLAN接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

set routing-options static route 0.0.0.0.explanation: 配置静态路由的下一跳地址。

set routing-options static route 172.30..explanation: 配置静态路由的下一跳地址。

set system login user \"172.30.0.8\" cla.template: set system login user [parameter1] class [parameter2] authentication plain-text-password [parameter3]
set system login user \"172.30.0.8\" cla.command: set system login user "172.30.0.8" class super-user authentication plain-text-password "<password>"
set system login user \"172.30.0.8\" cla.explanation: 配置系统登录用户，指定用户类为超级用户，并设置明文密码。

set system services aaa authentication-o.command: set system services aaa authentication-order radius local
set system services aaa authentication-o.explanation: 配置AAA认证顺序，先尝试radius认证，然后本地认证。

set system services aaa accounting-order.command: set system services aaa accounting-order radius local
set system services aaa accounting-order.explanation: 配置AAA记账顺序，先尝试radius记账，然后本地记账。

set system radius-server 172.30.0.8 secr.template: set system radius-server [parameter1] secret [parameter2] auth-port [parameter3] acct-port [parameter4]
set system radius-server 172.30.0.8 secr.command: set system radius-server 172.30.0.8 secret "<password>" auth-port 1812 acct-port 1813
set system radius-server 172.30.0.8 secr.explanation: 配置RADIUS服务器，包括服务器地址、共享密钥、认证端口和记账端口。

set firewall family inet filter ACL-1 te.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from source-address [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter ACL-1 te.command: set firewall family inet filter ACL-1 term 1 from source-address 172.30.0.8
set firewall family inet filter ACL-1 te.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的条件，指定源地址。

set firewall family inet filter ACL-1 te.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter ACL-1 te.command: set firewall family inet filter ACL-1 term 1 then accept
set firewall family inet filter ACL-1 te.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的动作，接受匹配的流量。

set firewall family inet filter ACL-1 te.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter ACL-1 te.command: set firewall family inet filter ACL-1 term 2 then reject
set firewall family inet filter ACL-1 te.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的动作，拒绝匹配的流量。

set system services dhcp-detect static-u.template: set system services dhcp-detect static-user interval [parameter1]
set system services dhcp-detect static-u.command: set system services dhcp-detect static-user interval 1
set system services dhcp-detect static-u.explanation: 配置DHCP检测静态用户的时间间隔。

parameters.name: interval
parameters.explanation: 检测间隔时间，单位为秒。

set system services dhcp-detect static-u.explanation: 启用DHCP检测静态用户功能。

set interfaces vlan unit 100 family inet.template: set interfaces vlan unit [parameter1] family inet address [parameter2]/[parameter3]
set interfaces vlan unit 100 family inet.command: set interfaces vlan unit 100 family inet address 172.30.0.1/24
set interfaces vlan unit 100 family inet.explanation: 配置VLAN接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

set ethernet-switching-options dhcp-snoo.command: set ethernet-switching-options dhcp-snooping trust interface ge-0/0/2.1

set ethernet-switching-options dhcp-snoo.template: set ethernet-switching-options dhcp-snooping rate-limit unicast threshold [parameter1] burst [parameter2]
set ethernet-switching-options dhcp-snoo.command: set ethernet-switching-options dhcp-snooping rate-limit unicast threshold 100 burst 10
set ethernet-switching-options dhcp-snoo.explanation: 配置DHCP Snooping单播速率限制的阈值和突发大小。
